extDescription.message: Adds a "Download this video" button that sends the page to the Eid Download desktop app.

errNotInstalled.message: Eid Download is not installed, or its browser connection is not registered. Install Eid Download, then restart the browser.

errNotAllowed.message: Eid Download does not allow this extension. Re-register the browser connection from Eid Download.

errAppNotRunning.message: Could not start Eid Download. Open the app and try again.

errAppTooOld.message: Your Eid Download app is too old for this button. Update Eid Download.

errToolsMissing.message: Video tools (yt-dlp/FFmpeg) are not installed yet. Open Eid Download and install them, then try again.

errDrm.message: This video is protected (DRM). Eid Download does not download protected media.

errTimeout.message: Eid Download took too long to answer. Try again.

errFailed.message: Something went wrong. Try again from the Eid Download app.

errNoQualities.message: No downloadable quality was found for this video.

optHover.message: When the mouse is over the video

optIfMissing.message: Playlists: if an item lacks the chosen quality

optMissHigher.message: Take the nearest higher one (up to 4K)

optExcluded.message: Do not show on these sites (one per line)

optPrivacy.message: Privacy: the button sends nothing until you click a download choice. It then sends only the page or video address to the Eid Download app on this computer: no cookies, no history, no tracking. Protected (DRM) videos are never offered.

optAccessMissing.message: The browser has not allowed Eid Download on web pages, so the "Download this video" button cannot appear. Allow it here (or from the browser's extensions menu: Eid Download > Always allow).

menuOpenInApp.message: Open in Eid Download (choose episodes, quality, folder)…

openedInApp.message: Opened in Eid Download: choose there.

errNoWindow.message: Only the background part of Eid Download is running. Open the Eid Download window and try again.
